description: Change of use of the ground floor unit from retail (Class E) to a restaurant and cafe (Use Class E (b). Installation of a extraction flue to the rear elevation (summary)
decision_conditions:
Prior to the commencement of any off-site delivery of food or drink from the premises, including where operated by a third party, the applicant shall submit to the LPA a Food and Drink Delivery Management Plan for approval. The submitted document shall set-out how the delivery service would be managed and include details on the management of delivery drivers, parking/storage of delivery vehicles and measures to ensure that no obstruction to the highway is caused. Any food or drink deliveries from the premises shall thereafter be undertaken in strict accordance with the approved document.

Reason: To ensure that the site's activities do not compromise the safe and efficient operation of the highway or the amenity of the site's neighbours.
